textAndButtonBannerData.ctaTitle: Ready to Scale Your Investment Platform Globally?
textAndButtonBannerData.ctaDescription: Experience unmatched speed, operational clarity, and automation across investor collections, withdrawals, and advisor payouts. Get started with Decentro today.

data.text: Collect investor funds and disburse withdrawals across markets with localised payment methods and a single, centralised treasury layer that eliminates the need to manage multiple banking relationships per country.

Automate recurring contributions including SIPs and auto-invest mandates, and redemption payouts tied to investor instructions across currencies, with full reconciliation to investor and folio-level data.

Embed fund collection and withdrawal payouts directly into third-party apps, super-apps, and neobank experiences without building banking infrastructure from scratch or managing complex compliance requirements.

Handle cross-border capital calls, distributions, and investor payouts with multi-currency treasury management and automated reconciliation that maps every transaction to investor IDs and fund accounts.

Support high-frequency, low-ticket contributions and fast withdrawal payouts for micro-investing, retirement savings, and goal-based savings products with predictable settlement cycles and minimal operational overhead.

Enter new geographies without rebuilding payment stacks, renegotiating local banking relationships, or managing FX complexity market by market. Launch globally with a single API-first infrastructure layer.

block1.heading:

block1.heading:

block1.heading:
Redemption-Ready
Infrastructure

block1extra.heading:
End-to-End Investor
Lifecycle Automation
block1extra.paragraph: From account funding to withdrawal, every transaction is linked to investor and folio data, enabling full traceability and eliminating manual reconciliation across the investment lifecycle.

block1extra.heading:

Reconciliation
block1extra.paragraph: Auto-map investor contributions, withdrawals, refunds, and partner payouts to investor IDs, folio and account numbers, and transaction references, reducing operational effort by up to 90%.

block1extra.heading:

Settlements
block1extra.paragraph: Multi-bank, multi-rail architecture ensures high uptime and consistent fund flows even during regional outages, keeping investor payouts and advisor commissions on schedule.

frequentlyAskedQuestions.query: How does Decentro support payment processing for investment platforms?
frequentlyAskedQuestions.solution: With virtual accounts, escrow-style workflows, automated settlements, and multi-bank infrastructure supporting SIP mandates, lump-sum investments, and redemption payouts across asset classes.

frequentlyAskedQuestions.query: Can I automate recurring investment mandates and SIP collections?
frequentlyAskedQuestions.solution: Yes. Payment triggers can be tied to investment schedules, NAV-based events, mandate approvals, or custom intervals—fully automated via NACH and UPI AutoPay.

frequentlyAskedQuestions.query: How reliable is the system for high-value investment transactions?
frequentlyAskedQuestions.solution: Decentro's multi-bank architecture ensures high uptime, lower settlement failures, and seamless fund flow management across broking, mutual fund, and alternative investment platforms.

frequentlyAskedQuestions.query: What is the integration timeline for investment platforms?
frequentlyAskedQuestions.solution: Most investment platforms go live within weeks using Decentro's APIs, pre-built UI modules, and flexible configuration tailored to SEBI-compliant fintech workflows.
